decisions.decision: Following a discussion with the Director and the Children's librarian, the Chair told a patron by email that the children's book would be removed from circulation. The patron complaint was handled through the challenge form.
decisions.quote: informed him that after a discussion with the director and the children's librarian the book would be removed from circulation.

decisions.decision: The policy sub-committee will meet to review the by-laws and present suggestions to the board.
decisions.quote: policy sub-committee will meet to review and present some suggestions for the board.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director's redrafted contract, starting July 1, 2022, included a one-time payment covering the salary increase differential for the first six months of 2022; the board approved the payment by motion.
budget_items.quote: the contract included a one-time payment to cover the salary increase differential for the first 6 months of 2022.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A requested increase for library materials; the minutes say the budget needs to be 16% of the municipally appropriated amount.
budget_items.quote: the budget needs to be 16% of the municipally appropriated amount.

budget_items.topic: Library requests to the town manager (utilities)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Requests to the town manager include a 9% increase for utilities; a trustee asked whether that figure was too low, and the Director said additional hours equal an 11% increase in hours.
budget_items.quote: corrected director's salary, 9% increase for utilities and additional money for programs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An increase in the CWMARS network membership assessment is expected as the library moves to full membership over three years; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: there will be an increase in the membership assessment for the cwmars network.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A request for funding to purchase technology; priorities named were the phone system, the server, and the public access computers. No dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: there is a request for funding to purchase technology.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Heating costs were reported as still low; no figure is printed.

topics.quote: we are in the 7th month. there have been no major issues. heating costs are still low.

the town caucus will be held on march 14th, 2022. two trustees are up for re-election: dick and donna.
the friends had a short meeting. fund-raising continues to go well.
kate asked about possible friday hours, would it be half days?
